1. ## **High Concept Statement**

| The premise of The Last Roll is a turn-based, board game with the winner either being the last player standing or to reach the end of the labyrinth. The Last Roll has RPG elements like obtaining buffs, collecting items, boss fights and player versus player combat or PVP. The Last Rolls allows players to be their own adventurer and explore the labyrinth in a way similar to a standard RPG like game. |
| :---- |

# 

2. # **FORMAL ELEMENTS**

| Players | 2-4 players, competitive, Pass and Play |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Objectives** | Be the first player to reach the end space of the board or become the last player left alive. |
| **Rules** | Players may have 1 to 3 dice for board movement, and 1 to 3 dice for combat. Players can freely communicate to other players |
| **Procedures** | Players roll a number of dice to move. |
| **Resources** | Movement Dice |
| **Conflict** | Other Players |
| **Boundaries** | The game’s board displayed on the screen, the entire from the start to the end. The pieces cannot go beyond either end. |
| **Outcome** | Win: First to finish traversing the labyrinth, or last player standing. |

3. # **CORE GAMEPLAY LOOP**

|   ![][image1] When a player begins their turn, they roll dice to move. The player moves that many spaces and then ends their turn. |
